assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service directly addresses the diagnosed atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The service directly addresses the diagnosed atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
This appeal is submitted in response to denial code PR-204.
The denial code PR-204 incorrectly determined the service is not covered.
